name: Ajulia Executive Search
status: operating (but flagged - state stop-work order against its affiliated payroll entity, unclaimed 2.5-star Google profile, and its website domain now redirects to an unrelated company)
website: https://www.ajuliaexecutivesearch.com - redirects to https://www.airbase1.com (an aviation web-design firm); no Ajulia content served
what_they_do: Staffing, executive search and recruitment firm. New Jersey Department of Labor describes the affiliated entity Ajulia Executive Payroll L.L.C. as a 'Staffing, executive search, and recruitment firm'; the Google listing is categorised as a temp agency. Historic site pages covered specialised search and placement and a job board.
customers: Employers hiring (per state filing and listing category); workers seeking placements

size_signals.signal: State stop-work order lists 90 workers affected and $1,227,351.33 owed, over work from Sept 2019 to Dec 2024 - indicates real placement volume
Google Maps address now 2 King Arthur Ct #10, North Brunswick, not the 51 W Prospect St address in state filings and in the batch

listing.reviews: count not shown in Maps limited view

website_review.trust_signals: none - the domain serves a different company's website
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Old site pages are still indexed by search engines but the domain itself now lands on airbase1.com, an aviation marketing company - inference: the domain lapsed or was re-registered, and old content is serving from cache
website_review.search_basics: Search results still show titles like 'Ajulia Executive Search' and 'Jobs - Ajulia Executive Search' for pages that no longer exist at that domain
top_issues: Domain no longer serves the firm - visitors land on an unrelated aviation web-design site
Google profile is unclaimed, unrated-for-hours, with no hours and a 2.5 average rating
Address and phone on Google disagree with state filings and the batch record

agent_readiness.notes: Findable 1: listing exists but is unclaimed ('Claim this business'), has no hours and no photos, and the linked site is a dead end. Answerable 0: no readable hours, services, service area or pay ranges on any live page. Bookable 0: no form or booking path at all.

operations_signals.signal: NJDOL issued a stop-work order on 21 Apr 2025 over $1,227,351 in unpaid unemployment/disability contributions, in discussions on a payment plan
Local coverage says the order affected 90 workers and was the third stop-work order involving the company - inference: payroll and compliance admin is a live pain point

top_opportunities.opportunity: Recover the web presence: restore or replace the domain and rebuild a minimal site with live job listings
top_opportunities.evidence: ajuliaexecutivesearch.com 302-redirects to airbase1.com; a same-origin fetch policy refuses the cross-origin redirect

top_opportunities.opportunity: Claim the Google Business Profile, fix NAP (address and phone) and rebuild reviews after a 2.5 average
top_opportunities.evidence: Maps shows 'Claim this business', no hours, and a 2.5 rating
State order cites unpaid contributions across 2019-2024 and a seven-figure liability

scores.reasons: Gap 5: no working website, unclaimed profile, 2.5 rating. Ability to pay 1: seven-figure state liability and a stop-work order make them a poor bet. Ease 1: any project is tangled with distressed finances and an ownership/domain question. Evidence 4: state press release, Maps listing and the redirect all directly verified.
